title: Umphathi Welangabi Elingacimi
intro: Umuntu umi emnyango wendawo eyesabekayo kakhulu endaweni engabonakali, ephathiswe umsebenzi okungekho muntu owufisayo. Lapho imiphefumulo ehluphekayo ikhala icela isihe, impendulo eqinile izwakala emakamelweni omlilo. Ungakwazi yini ukuthola ukuthi ungubani lo mlondolozi waphakade?
clues: Ngimi emnyango wendawo eyesabekayo yesijeziso endaweni engabonakali.
Umlilo ovuthayo, ongacimekiyo uyisisekelo somsebenzi wami obalulekile.
Imiphefumulo ehluphekayo ibiza igama lami, icela impumuzo ekuhluphekeni kwayo okungapheli.
Uma becela, ngithi ngeke bahambe, nanini.
Angisiye umuntu, futhi angisiye uJinn — ngiyisidalwa esidalwe ngokulalela okumsulwa.
Ngiyingelosi eyinhloko ebekwe njengomqaphi waphakade weSihogo Somlilo.

trial.label: Isivivinyo/Umcimbi
options: Abantu baseSihogweni banxusa ukuba ukuhlupheka kwabo kuphele
Icilongo liyashaywa ukuze kuboniswe uSuku Lokwahlulela
Umprofethi uphonswa emlilweni omkhulu ngabantu babo
Udonga oluqinile lwakhiwe ukuze luvikele isizwe esonakele
trial.answer: Abantu baseSihogweni banxusa ukuba ukuhlupheka kwabo kuphele

outcome.label: Umphumela
options: Abantu abahlala esihogweni batshelwa ukuthi bazohlala phakade
Abahlali baseSihogweni banikezwa ithuba lesibili lokukholwa
outcome.answer: Abantu abahlala esihogweni batshelwa ukuthi bazohlala phakade

arabic: وَنَادَوْا۟ يَـٰمَـٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّـٰكِثُونَ
verse: And they will call, "O Mālik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain." (43:77)
